questions.question: What is the central output invariant of a production layout-analysis stage?
options: Every region remains traceable to page coordinates, model evidence, and the source page
Every page produces exactly five regions
OCR text replaces all page geometry
The highest model confidence is treated as ground truth
questions.explanation: Coordinates, labels, scores, versions, and source identity make region decisions inspectable and replayable.

questions.question: In the detection-policy lab, what can happen when the confidence floor rises above a valid caption's score?
options: The caption region is dropped and expected coverage falls
The caption is automatically reconstructed from the figure
Non-maximum suppression increases its score
Reading order becomes correct by definition
questions.explanation: A score threshold is a routing policy. Raising it can remove false positives, but it can also remove real low-scoring regions.

questions.question: What problem does class-aware non-maximum suppression address in this lesson?
options: Multiple overlapping detections of the same semantic region
OCR language selection
Cross-page document hierarchy
GPU dependency installation
questions.explanation: The policy keeps the stronger same-class box when overlap exceeds the declared IoU threshold, reducing duplicate downstream crops.

questions.question: Why is LayoutLMv3 not simply another selectable LayoutParser detector in the lesson?
options: It is a separate multimodal Transformer family for document understanding with its own processing and task heads
It cannot use page images
It only performs PDF rendering
It is an overlap-suppression algorithm
questions.explanation: LayoutParser exposes detection and layout utilities; LayoutLMv3 is a distinct multimodal model architecture that combines text, boxes, and image features for downstream tasks.

questions.question: Why can sorting regions only by vertical position fail on a two-column page?
options: It can interleave the left and right columns even when each column should be read as a unit
It removes all region labels
It changes the original image resolution
It always places the footer first
questions.explanation: Nearby y-coordinates do not encode column membership. Reading order needs layout lanes, relationships, or another learned/ruled structure signal.

questions.question: Which release evaluation is strongest for a layout-analysis change?
options: Region precision and recall, reading-order quality, and downstream extraction checks sliced by document family and image condition
Average confidence on one clean PDF
GPU memory usage alone
A visual inspection of the model's easiest training page
questions.explanation: Averages can hide critical failures. Detection, sequence, and downstream usefulness should be measured on representative and difficult slices.
